title: 1990 Haro BMX Catalog
subtitle: Official catalog existence verified; exact BMXMuseum reference ID remains unresolved.
summary: Haro's official BMX archive verifies a manufacturer-issued 1990 catalog. An independent catalog reconstruction organizes six model entries for the year, while a public index exposes a BMXMuseum reference titled “1990 Haro BMX Catalog.” The exact BMXMuseum numeric reference ID, edition and page-for-page match remain unresolved.

claims.statement: Haro issued a BMX catalog for 1990.
claims.public_wording: Haro's official archive verifies the existence of a 1990 BMX catalog.
claims.evidence_summary: The first-party archive lists 1990 among its historical BMX catalog years.

claims.statement: The exact BMXMuseum numeric reference ID has been recovered.
claims.public_wording: A public index exposes the BMXMuseum reference title, but its numeric reference ID has not been recovered.
claims.evidence_summary: Search indexing exposes the title and a BMXMuseum-hosted image filename, but no ordinary public backlink reveals a /reference/{id} URL.
claims.does_not_prove: The image filename cannot be used to infer or invent the reference ID.

claims.statement: The reconstruction is necessarily the same edition as the BMXMuseum reference.
claims.public_wording: The reconstruction is a useful model-year guide, but edition, market and page matching remain open.
claims.evidence_summary: Official archive, reconstruction and title indexing support the same year without proving identical files or editions.
claims.does_not_prove: Matching year and title do not establish identical pagination or market specification.
